---- MODULE btree ----
EXTENDS btreeDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AgT == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL AgF == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems
LOCAL AgW == INSTANCE WellFoundedInduction

\* ---------- bridges between prefixed and local library operators ----------

THEOREM AgBridgeFin == \A S : AgF!IsFiniteSet(S) <=> IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY DEF AgF!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

THEOREM AgBridgeCard == \A S : AgF!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
  BY DEF AgF!Cardinality, Cardinality

\* ---------- basic facts about the key order ----------

THEOREM AgIrr == \A x \in Keys : ~(x < x)
  BY KeysAreOrdered
  DEF IsStrictlyTotallyOrderedUnder, IsStrictlyTotallyOrdered,
      IsStrictlyPartiallyOrdered, IsIrreflexive

THEOREM AgTrans == \A x, y, z \in Keys : x < y /\ y < z => x < z
  BY KeysAreOrdered
  DEF IsStrictlyTotallyOrderedUnder, IsStrictlyTotallyOrdered,
      IsStrictlyPartiallyOrdered, IsTransitive

THEOREM AgTotal == \A x, y \in Keys : x # y => (x < y \/ y < x)
  BY KeysAreOrdered
  DEF IsStrictlyTotallyOrderedUnder, IsStrictlyTotallyOrdered

THEOREM AgAsym == \A x, y \in Keys : x < y => ~(y < x)
  BY AgIrr, AgTrans

(***************************************************************************)
(* TLAPS axiomatises  =<  only on Int, so reflexivity of  =<  (equivalently *)
(* of  >= ) is not derivable for the abstract constant set Keys.  The       *)
(* predicate below isolates exactly that fact; every lemma that has to      *)
(* decide a  >=  test on keys takes it as an explicit hypothesis.           *)
(***************************************************************************)
AgRefl == \A x \in Keys : x >= x

THEOREM AgGeqI == ASSUME NEW a, NEW b, b < a PROVE a >= b
  BY AgT!SMTT("r10")

THEOREM AgGeqE == ASSUME NEW a, NEW b, a >= b PROVE b < a \/ b = a
  BY AgT!SMTT("r10")

THEOREM AgGeqKey ==
  ASSUME AgRefl, NEW a \in Keys, NEW b \in Keys
  PROVE  (a >= b) <=> (b < a \/ a = b)
<1>1. (b < a \/ a = b) => a >= b
  <2>1. CASE b < a
    BY <2>1, AgGeqI
  <2>2. CASE a = b
    BY <2>2 DEF AgRefl
  <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>2. (a >= b) => (b < a \/ a = b)
  BY AgGeqE
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2

THEOREM AgNotGeqKey ==
  ASSUME AgRefl, NEW a \in Keys, NEW b \in Keys, ~(a >= b)
  PROVE  a < b
<1>1. ~(b < a) /\ a # b
  BY AgGeqKey
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, AgTotal

\* ---------- existence of extrema in finite non-empty key sets ----------

THEOREM AgMaxExists ==
  ASSUME NEW S, S \subseteq Keys, IsFiniteSet(S), S # {}
  PROVE  \E m \in S : \A y \in S \ {m} : y < m
<1> DEFINE P(T) == (T \subseteq Keys /\ T # {}) => \E m \in T : \A y \in T \ {m} : y < m
<1>0. AgF!IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY AgBridgeFin
<1>1. P({})
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. ASSUME NEW T \in SUBSET S, AgF!IsFiniteSet(T), P(T), NEW x \in S \ T
      PROVE  P(T \cup {x})
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME T \cup {x} \subseteq Keys
               PROVE  \E m \in T \cup {x} : \A y \in (T \cup {x}) \ {m} : y < m
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. CASE T = {}
    BY <2>1
  <2>2. CASE T # {}
    <3>1. PICK m \in T : \A y \in T \ {m} : y < m
      BY <1>2, <2>2
    <3>2. x # m /\ x \in Keys /\ m \in Keys
      BY <1>2, <3>1
    <3>3. CASE m < x
      <4>1. \A y \in (T \cup {x}) \ {x} : y < x
        <5>1. ASSUME NEW y \in (T \cup {x}) \ {x} PROVE y < x
          <6>1. y \in T /\ y \in Keys
            OBVIOUS
          <6>2. CASE y = m
            BY <6>2, <3>3
          <6>3. CASE y # m
            BY <6>1, <6>3, <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, AgTrans
          <6> QED BY <6>2, <6>3
        <5> QED BY <5>1
      <4> QED BY <4>1
    <3>4. CASE x < m
      <4>1. \A y \in (T \cup {x}) \ {m} : y < m
        BY <3>1, <3>4
      <4> QED BY <4>1, <3>1
    <3> QED BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, AgTotal
  <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>3. P(S)
  <2> HIDE DEF P
  <2> QED BY <1>0, <1>1, <1>2, AgF!FS_Induction, AgT!IsaM("blast")
<1> QED BY <1>3

THEOREM AgMinExists ==
  ASSUME NEW S, S \subseteq Keys, IsFiniteSet(S), S # {}
  PROVE  \E m \in S : \A y \in S \ {m} : m < y
<1> DEFINE P(T) == (T \subseteq Keys /\ T # {}) => \E m \in T : \A y \in T \ {m} : m < y
<1>0. AgF!IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY AgBridgeFin
<1>1. P({})
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. ASSUME NEW T \in SUBSET S, AgF!IsFiniteSet(T), P(T), NEW x \in S \ T
      PROVE  P(T \cup {x})
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME T \cup {x} \subseteq Keys
               PROVE  \E m \in T \cup {x} : \A y \in (T \cup {x}) \ {m} : m < y
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. CASE T = {}
    BY <2>1
  <2>2. CASE T # {}
    <3>1. PICK m \in T : \A y \in T \ {m} : m < y
      BY <1>2, <2>2
    <3>2. x # m /\ x \in Keys /\ m \in Keys
      BY <1>2, <3>1
    <3>3. CASE x < m
      <4>1. \A y \in (T \cup {x}) \ {x} : x < y
        <5>1. ASSUME NEW y \in (T \cup {x}) \ {x} PROVE x < y
          <6>1. y \in T /\ y \in Keys
            OBVIOUS
          <6>2. CASE y = m
            BY <6>2, <3>3
          <6>3. CASE y # m
            BY <6>1, <6>3, <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, AgTrans
          <6> QED BY <6>2, <6>3
        <5> QED BY <5>1
      <4> QED BY <4>1
    <3>4. CASE m < x
      <4>1. \A y \in (T \cup {x}) \ {m} : m < y
        BY <3>1, <3>4
      <4> QED BY <4>1, <3>1
    <3> QED BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, AgTotal
  <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>3. P(S)
  <2> HIDE DEF P
  <2> QED BY <1>0, <1>1, <1>2, AgF!FS_Induction, AgT!IsaM("blast")
<1> QED BY <1>3

\* ---------- every rank is realised in a finite key set ----------

THEOREM AgIntervalCard ==
  ASSUME NEW m \in Nat, m # 0
  PROVE  IsFiniteSet(0 .. (m-1)) /\ Cardinality(0 .. (m-1)) = m
<1>1. 0 \in AgF!Int /\ (m-1) \in AgF!Int
  BY AgT!SMTT("r10")
<1>2. AgF!IsFiniteSet(0 .. (m-1)) /\ AgF!Cardinality(0 .. (m-1)) = IF 0 > m-1 THEN 0 ELSE (m-1)-0+1
  BY <1>1, AgF!FS_Interval
<1>3. (IF 0 > m-1 THEN 0 ELSE (m-1)-0+1) = m
  BY AgT!SMTT("r10")
<1> QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3, AgBridgeFin, AgBridgeCard

THEOREM AgRankInj ==
  ASSUME NEW S, S \subseteq Keys, IsFiniteSet(S),
         NEW k1 \in S, NEW k2 \in S, k1 < k2
  PROVE  Cardinality({x \in S : x < k1}) # Cardinality({x \in S : x < k2})
<1> DEFINE A == {x \in S : x < k1}
<1> DEFINE B == {x \in S : x < k2}
<1>1. A \subseteq B /\ A # B
  <2>1. \A x \in A : x \in B
    BY AgTrans
  <2>2. k1 \in B /\ k1 \notin A
    BY AgIrr
  <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>2. AgF!IsFiniteSet(S) /\ B \in SUBSET S /\ A \in SUBSET B
  BY <1>1, AgBridgeFin
<1>3. AgF!IsFiniteSet(B)
  BY <1>2, AgF!FS_Subset
<1>4. AgF!Cardinality(B) = AgF!Cardinality(A) => B = A
  BY <1>2, <1>3, AgF!FS_Subset
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>4, AgBridgeCard

THEOREM AgRankSurj ==
  ASSUME NEW S, S \subseteq Keys, IsFiniteSet(S),
         NEW j \in 0 .. (Cardinality(S) - 1)
  PROVE  \E k \in S : Cardinality({x \in S : x < k}) = j
<1> DEFINE m == Cardinality(S)
<1> DEFINE T == 0 .. (m-1)
<1> DEFINE g == [k \in S |-> Cardinality({x \in S : x < k})]
<1>0. m \in Nat
  BY AgBridgeFin, AgBridgeCard, AgF!FS_CardinalityType
<1>00. m # 0
  BY <1>0, AgT!SMTT("r10")
<1>1. ASSUME NEW k \in S PROVE Cardinality({x \in S : x < k}) \in T
  <2> DEFINE A == {x \in S : x < k}
  <2>1. A \subseteq (S \ {k})
    BY AgIrr
  <2>2. AgF!IsFiniteSet(S)
    BY AgBridgeFin
  <2>3. AgF!IsFiniteSet(S \ {k}) /\ AgF!Cardinality(S \ {k}) = m - 1
    BY <2>2, AgBridgeCard, AgF!FS_RemoveElement
  <2>4. AgF!Cardinality(A) <= AgF!Cardinality(S \ {k}) /\ AgF!Cardinality(A) \in Nat
    BY <2>1, <2>3, AgF!FS_Subset, AgF!FS_CardinalityType
  <2> QED
    BY <2>3, <2>4, <1>0, <1>00, AgBridgeCard, AgT!SMTT("r10")
<1>2. g \in AgF!Injection(S, T)
  <2>1. g \in [S -> T]
    BY <1>1
  <2>2. AgF!IsInjective(g)
    <3>1. ASSUME NEW a \in S, NEW b \in S, g[a] = g[b], a # b PROVE FALSE
      <4>1. a < b \/ b < a
        BY <3>1, AgTotal
      <4>2. CASE a < b
        BY <3>1, <4>2, AgRankInj
      <4>3. CASE b < a
        BY <3>1, <4>3, AgRankInj
      <4> QED BY <4>1, <4>2, <4>3
    <3> QED BY <3>1 DEF AgF!IsInjective
  <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2 DEF AgF!Injection
<1>3. AgF!IsFiniteSet(T) /\ AgF!Cardinality(T) = m
  BY <1>0, <1>00, AgIntervalCard, AgBridgeFin, AgBridgeCard
<1>4. AgF!Cardinality(S) = AgF!Cardinality(T)
  BY <1>3, AgBridgeCard
<1>5. g \in AgF!Surjection(S, T)
  BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, AgF!FS_Injection
<1> QED
  BY <1>5 DEF AgF!Surjection

THEOREM AgPivotIn ==
  ASSUME NEW S, S \subseteq Keys, IsFiniteSet(S), S # {}
  PROVE  /\ PivotOf(S) \in S
         /\ {x \in S : x < PivotOf(S)} # {} \/ Cardinality(S) = 1
<1> DEFINE m == Cardinality(S)
<1> DEFINE Pv(k) == \/ Cardinality({x \in S : x < k}) = Cardinality({x \in S : x > k})
                    \/ Cardinality({x \in S : x < k}) = Cardinality({x \in S : x > k}) + 1
<1>0. m \in Nat /\ m # 0
  BY AgBridgeFin, AgBridgeCard, AgF!FS_CardinalityType, AgF!FS_EmptySet
<1>1. (m \div 2) \in 0 .. (m-1)
  BY <1>0, AgT!SMTT("r10")
<1>2. PICK k \in S : Cardinality({x \in S : x < k}) = m \div 2
  BY <1>1, AgRankSurj
<1>3. Cardinality({x \in S : x > k}) = m - 1 - (m \div 2)
  <2> DEFINE A == {x \in S : x < k}
  <2> DEFINE B == {x \in S : x > k}
  <2>1. AgF!IsFiniteSet(S) /\ A \in SUBSET S /\ B \in SUBSET S
    BY AgBridgeFin
  <2>2. AgF!IsFiniteSet(A) /\ AgF!IsFiniteSet(B)
    BY <2>1, AgF!FS_Subset
  <2>3. A \cup B = S \ {k}
    <3>1. \A x \in S : x # k => (x < k \/ k < x)
      BY AgTotal
    <3>2. \A x \in A \cup B : x # k
      BY AgIrr
    <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>2
  <2>4. A \cap B = {}
    BY AgIrr, AgTrans
  <2>5. AgF!Cardinality(A \cup B) = AgF!Cardinality(A) + AgF!Cardinality(B) - AgF!Cardinality(A \cap B)
    BY <2>2, AgF!FS_Union
  <2>6. AgF!Cardinality(S \ {k}) = m - 1
    BY <2>1, AgBridgeCard, AgF!FS_RemoveElement
  <2>7. AgF!Cardinality({}) = 0
    BY AgF!FS_EmptySet
  <2>8. AgF!Cardinality(A) \in Nat /\ AgF!Cardinality(B) \in Nat
    BY <2>2, AgF!FS_CardinalityType
  <2> QED
    BY <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7, <2>8, <1>2, <1>0, AgBridgeCard, AgT!SMTT("r10")
<1>4. Pv(k)
  BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>0, AgT!SMTT("r15")
<1>5. PivotOf(S) \in S /\ Pv(PivotOf(S))
  BY <1>4 DEF PivotOf
<1>6. Cardinality(S) # 1 => {x \in S : x < PivotOf(S)} # {}
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME m # 1, {x \in S : x < PivotOf(S)} = {}
               PROVE  FALSE
    OBVIOUS
  <2> DEFINE p == PivotOf(S)
  <2> DEFINE A == {x \in S : x < p}
  <2> DEFINE B == {x \in S : x > p}
  <2>1. AgF!IsFiniteSet(S) /\ A \in SUBSET S /\ B \in SUBSET S
    BY AgBridgeFin
  <2>2. AgF!IsFiniteSet(A) /\ AgF!IsFiniteSet(B)
    BY <2>1, AgF!FS_Subset
  <2>3. A \cup B = S \ {p}
    <3>1. \A x \in S : x # p => (x < p \/ p < x)
      BY <1>5, AgTotal
    <3>2. \A x \in A \cup B : x # p
      BY AgIrr
    <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>2
  <2>4. A \cap B = {}
    BY AgIrr, AgTrans
  <2>5. AgF!Cardinality(A \cup B) = AgF!Cardinality(A) + AgF!Cardinality(B) - AgF!Cardinality(A \cap B)
    BY <2>2, AgF!FS_Union
  <2>6. AgF!Cardinality(S \ {p}) = m - 1
    BY <1>5, <2>1, AgBridgeCard, AgF!FS_RemoveElement
  <2>7. AgF!Cardinality({}) = 0
    BY AgF!FS_EmptySet
  <2>8. AgF!Cardinality(A) \in Nat /\ AgF!Cardinality(B) \in Nat
    BY <2>2, AgF!FS_CardinalityType
  <2>9. Cardinality(A) = 0
    BY <2>7, AgBridgeCard
  <2> QED
    BY <1>5, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7, <2>8, <2>9, <1>0, AgBridgeCard,
       AgT!SMTT("r15")
<1> QED
  BY <1>5, <1>6

\* ---------- NIL is not a node ----------

THEOREM AgNilNotNode == NIL \notin Nodes
<1>1. \E x : x \notin Nodes
  <2> DEFINE R == {x \in Nodes : x \notin x}
  <2>1. R \notin Nodes
    <3> SUFFICES ASSUME R \in Nodes PROVE FALSE
      OBVIOUS
    <3>1. R \in R <=> R \notin R
      OBVIOUS
    <3> QED BY <3>1
  <2> QED BY <2>1
<1> QED
  BY <1>1 DEF NIL

\* ---------- Max and ChildNodeFor ----------

THEOREM AgMaxOf ==
  ASSUME NEW S, S \subseteq Keys, IsFiniteSet(S), S # {}
  PROVE  Max(S) \in S /\ \A y \in S \ {Max(S)} : y < Max(S)
<1>1. \E m \in S : \A y \in S \ {m} : m > y
  BY AgMaxExists
<1> QED
  BY <1>1 DEF Max

THEOREM AgChildNodeFor ==
  ASSUME AgRefl, NEW nd, NEW key \in Keys,
         keysOf[nd] \subseteq Keys, IsFiniteSet(keysOf[nd])
  PROVE  \/ (ChildNodeFor(nd, key) = lastOf[nd] /\ \A k \in keysOf[nd] : ~(key < k))
         \/ \E k \in keysOf[nd] :
              /\ ChildNodeFor(nd, key) = childOf[nd, k]
              /\ key < k
              /\ \A j \in keysOf[nd] : key < j => ~(j < k)
<1> DEFINE keys == keysOf[nd]
<1> DEFINE maxKey == Max(keys)
<1> DEFINE closestKey == CHOOSE k \in keys : /\ k > key
                                             /\ ~(\E j \in keys \ {k} : j > key /\ j < k)
<1>1. ChildNodeFor(nd, key) = IF keys = {} \/ key >= maxKey THEN lastOf[nd]
                                                            ELSE childOf[nd, closestKey]
  BY DEF ChildNodeFor
<1>2. CASE keys = {} \/ key >= maxKey
  <2>1. \A k \in keys : ~(key < k)
    <3>1. CASE keys = {}
      BY <3>1
    <3>2. CASE keys # {} /\ key >= maxKey
      <4>1. maxKey \in keys /\ \A y \in keys \ {maxKey} : y < maxKey
        BY <3>2, AgMaxOf
      <4>2. maxKey < key \/ maxKey = key
        BY <3>2, AgGeqE
      <4>3. ~(key < maxKey)
        BY <4>1, <4>2, AgIrr, AgAsym
      <4>4. ASSUME NEW k \in keys, key < k PROVE FALSE
        <5>1. CASE k = maxKey
          BY <5>1, <4>3, <4>4
        <5>2. CASE k # maxKey
          <6>1. k < maxKey
            BY <5>2, <4>1
          <6>2. key < maxKey
            BY <4>4, <6>1, <4>1, AgTrans
          <6> QED BY <6>2, <4>3
        <5> QED BY <5>1, <5>2
      <4> QED BY <4>4
    <3> QED BY <1>2, <3>1, <3>2
  <2> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <2>1
<1>3. CASE ~(keys = {} \/ key >= maxKey)
  <2> DEFINE G == {k \in keys : key < k}
  <2>1. maxKey \in keys /\ \A y \in keys \ {maxKey} : y < maxKey
    BY <1>3, AgMaxOf
  <2>2. key < maxKey
    BY <1>3, <2>1, AgNotGeqKey
  <2>3. G # {} /\ G \subseteq Keys /\ IsFiniteSet(G)
    <3>1. AgF!IsFiniteSet(keys) /\ G \in SUBSET keys
      BY AgBridgeFin
    <3> QED BY <2>2, <2>1, <3>1, AgF!FS_Subset, AgBridgeFin
  <2>4. PICK c \in G : \A y \in G \ {c} : c < y
    BY <2>3, AgMinExists
  <2>5. c \in keys /\ c > key /\ ~(\E j \in keys \ {c} : j > key /\ j < c)
    <3>1. c \in keys /\ key < c
      BY <2>4
    <3>2. ASSUME NEW j \in keys \ {c}, key < j, j < c PROVE FALSE
      <4>1. j \in G \ {c}
        BY <3>2
      <4>2. c < j
        BY <4>1, <2>4
      <4> QED BY <3>2, <4>2, <3>1, AgIrr, AgTrans
    <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>2
  <2>6. closestKey \in keys /\ closestKey > key
        /\ ~(\E j \in keys \ {closestKey} : j > key /\ j < closestKey)
    BY <2>5
  <2>7. \A j \in keys : key < j => ~(j < closestKey)
    BY <2>6, AgIrr
  <2> QED
    BY <1>1, <1>3, <2>6, <2>7
<1> QED BY <1>2, <1>3
\* ---------- the tree carries a level function, hence is well founded ----------

AgHasP(m) == \E p \in Nodes : (\E k \in Keys : m = childOf[p, k]) \/ lastOf[p] = m

AgLvlOk(L) ==
  /\ L \in [Nodes -> Nat]
  /\ \A n \in Nodes : isLeaf[n] => L[n] = 0
  /\ \A n \in Nodes : ~isLeaf[n] => L[n] # 0
  /\ \A n \in Nodes : lastOf[n] \in Nodes => L[lastOf[n]] = L[n] - 1
  /\ \A n \in Nodes : \A k \in Keys : childOf[n, k] \in Nodes => L[childOf[n, k]] = L[n] - 1

AgHasLvl == \E L : AgLvlOk(L)

AgChildRel ==
  { p \in Nodes \X Nodes :
      /\ ~isLeaf[p[2]]
      /\ \/ p[1] = lastOf[p[2]]
         \/ \E k \in keysOf[p[2]] : p[1] = childOf[p[2], k] }

AgTreeWF ==
  /\ root \in Nodes
  /\ isLeaf \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ keysOf \in [Nodes -> SUBSET Keys]
  /\ lastOf \in [Nodes -> Nodes \union {NIL}]
  /\ \A n \in Nodes : IsFiniteSet(keysOf[n])
  /\ \A n \in Nodes : ~isLeaf[n] => lastOf[n] \in Nodes
  /\ \A n \in Nodes : ~isLeaf[n] => \A k \in keysOf[n] : childOf[n, k] \in Nodes
  /\ \A n \in Nodes : lastOf[n] \in Nodes => ~IsFree(lastOf[n])
  /\ \A n \in Nodes : \A k \in Keys : childOf[n, k] \in Nodes => ~IsFree(childOf[n, k])
  /\ AgHasLvl

THEOREM AgChildStep ==
  ASSUME AgRefl, AgTreeWF, NEW n \in Nodes, ~isLeaf[n], NEW key \in Keys
  PROVE  /\ ChildNodeFor(n, key) \in Nodes
         /\ <<ChildNodeFor(n, key), n>> \in AgChildRel
         /\ ~IsFree(ChildNodeFor(n, key))
         /\ AgHasP(ChildNodeFor(n, key))
<1>1. keysOf[n] \subseteq Keys /\ IsFiniteSet(keysOf[n])
  BY DEF AgTreeWF
<1>2. \/ ChildNodeFor(n, key) = lastOf[n]
      \/ \E k \in keysOf[n] : ChildNodeFor(n, key) = childOf[n, k]
  BY <1>1, AgChildNodeFor
<1>3. CASE ChildNodeFor(n, key) = lastOf[n]
  <2>1. lastOf[n] \in Nodes /\ ~IsFree(lastOf[n])
    BY DEF AgTreeWF
  <2>2. AgHasP(lastOf[n])
    BY <2>1 DEF AgHasP
  <2> QED
    BY <1>3, <2>1, <2>2 DEF AgChildRel
<1>4. CASE \E k \in keysOf[n] : ChildNodeFor(n, key) = childOf[n, k]
  <2>1. PICK k \in keysOf[n] : ChildNodeFor(n, key) = childOf[n, k]
    BY <1>4
  <2>2. childOf[n, k] \in Nodes /\ ~IsFree(childOf[n, k]) /\ k \in Keys
    BY <1>1, <2>1 DEF AgTreeWF
  <2>3. AgHasP(childOf[n, k])
    BY <2>2 DEF AgHasP
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3 DEF AgChildRel
<1> QED BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>4
